school: 文学批评（以小说戏曲评点为独立学术体裁的明末清初批评家）
historical_significance: 金圣叹（1608-1661），本姓张，名采，字若采，苏州吴县人，明末清初文学批评家，'中国小说批评之父'。科举赶考时改籍冒姓金，名喟，字圣叹；少为诸生而狂放不羁；明亡后绝意仕进，选定《离骚》《庄子》《史记》《杜诗》《水浒》《西厢》为'六才子书'，以评点为独立著述体裁——完成《水浒传》第五才子书（1641 前后）与《西厢记》第六才子书（1656 前后）两种评本：删改正文（腰斩《水浒》于七十回'惊恶梦'、截《西厢》为四本一折）、系统发明读法、回评、夹批、眉批多层批语体例，'《水浒》所叙，叙一百八人，人有其性情，人有其气质，人有其形状，人有其声口'——把'性格'确立为小说人物的第一分析单位；顺治十八年（1661）吴县'哭庙案'，因文告列名被以'倡乱'罪斩于南京，临刑笑语从容，传遗言'豆腐干与花生米同嚼有火腿滋味'；其'金批'体例被脂砚斋移用于《红楼梦》批评，小说评点三百年格局由此奠定。
historical_significance_en: Jin Shengtan (1608-1661), originally Zhang Cai, courtesy name Ruocai, a native of Wu County, Suzhou, literary critic at the Ming-Qing transition and 'the father of Chinese fiction criticism'. He changed his registered surname to Jin, taking the name Kui and courtesy name Shengtan before an examination; a government student in youth, famously unrestrained; after the Ming fell he abandoned office and named the Li Sao, Zhuangzi, Shiji, Du Fu's poems, the Water Margin and the Western Chamber the 'Six Books of Genius', making marginal commentary an independent genre of writing — completing two annotated editions, the Water Margin (fifth book of genius, c. 1641) and the Western Chamber (sixth, c. 1656): he cut the texts (lopping the Water Margin at chapter seventy with a 'dreadful dream', halving the Western Chamber to four acts), systematically invented the apparatus of 'how to read' essays, chapter prefaces, between-line and top-margin comments — 'The Water Margin narrates one hundred and eight men; each has his temperament, his qi and manner, his appearance, his voice' — establishing 'character' as the primary analytic unit of the novel. In the Amiao case of 1661 at Wu County he was seized with other literati for his name on a proclamation and beheaded at Nanjing for 'inciting disorder', smiling composedly at execution, his legendary last words a jest that dried tofu chewed with peanuts tastes of ham; the 'Jin-comment' apparatus was carried by the Rou-shi Zhai to Dream of the Red Chamber, and the three-century shape of fiction commentary was set by him.
unique_thinking: 金圣叹思维模式的独特性在于'批评即再创作'的方法自觉：他不把评点当作读者的附庸，而当作与原文同构的独立文体——(1)裁剪即立论：腰斩《水浒》以'惊恶梦'断招安、截《西厢》'足恸哭而止'——删改不是破坏文本而是用文本结构本身表达文学判断，批评家以'编辑权'行使'批评权'；(2)性格是第一分析单位：'人有其性情，人有其气质，人有其形状，人有其声口'——在人物心理尚未成为普遍概念的时代，把小说价值从故事推进到人物声口，成为后来叙事学'focalization'的本土先声；(3)读者工程：读法、回评、夹批分层配置——把'如何阅读'本身做成显式方法，批评的对象从作品扩展到读者；(4)游戏精神与死亡的对抗：临刑笑语、豆腐干与花生米——把生命的终局也当作一次文体表演，审美态度覆盖生死。
unique_thinking_en: The uniqueness of Jin Shengtan's thinking is the self-conscious method of 'criticism as re-creation': commentary is not a reader's appendage but a genre structurally co-equal with the text. (1) Cutting as argument: lopping the Water Margin at a 'dreadful dream' to end the amnesty, halving the Western Chamber 'where grief exhausts itself' — alteration is not vandalism but literary judgment expressed through textual structure itself; the critic wields the right of criticism through the right of editing. (2) Character as the primary analytic unit: 'each of the one hundred and eight has his temperament, his manner, his appearance, his voice' — before psychology became a general concept he moved the novel's value from story to voice and person, a native anticipation of focalization in narratology. (3) Engineering the reader: 'how to read' essays, chapter prefaces, layered interlinear comments — 'how to read' itself made an explicit method, the object of criticism extended from work to reader. (4) Play against death: smiling at the executioner, the tofu-and-peanut joke — even the end of life staged as a performance of style, the aesthetic attitude covering life and death alike.
civilization_zh: 明末清初的江南评点世界：生于苏州吴县（1608），本姓张，名采，字若采，后因科举赶考时改籍冒姓金，名喟，字圣叹；一说取义于《论语》'喟然而叹'；少年为诸生，以狂放知名；明亡后绝意仕进，以评点《水浒传》《西厢记》《离骚》《庄子》《史记》《杜诗》为'六才子书'，实际完成《水浒传》（第五才子书，1641 前后）与《西厢记》（第六才子书，1656 前后）两种评本；删改《水浒》七十回以'惊恶梦'截断招安，腰斩《西厢》为四本一折以'足恸哭而止'；顺治十八年（1661）'哭庙案'中因哭庙文告与众秀才同被逮，以'倡乱'罪斩于南京，临刑笑语，遗言'豆腐干与花生米同嚼，有火腿滋味'；评点体经其手而成显学，'金批'影响脂砚斋批《红楼梦》及后世小说批评三百年
civilization_en: The world of Jiangnan commentary at the Ming-Qing transition: born in Wu County, Suzhou (1608), originally surnamed Zhang, personal name Cai, courtesy name Ruocai — he changed his registered surname to Jin, took the name Kui and courtesy name Shengtan ('a sigh of wonder') before an examination; a government student in youth, famous for his wild independence; after the Ming fell he abandoned officialdom and ranked the Li Sao, Zhuangzi, Records of the Grand Historian, Du Fu's poems, the Water Margin and the Western Chamber as the 'Six Books of Genius', actually completing annotated editions of the Water Margin (the fifth book of genius, c. 1641) and the Western Chamber (the sixth, c. 1656); he cut the Water Margin to seventy chapters ending in a 'dreadful dream' to lop off the amnesty, and halved the Western Chamber to four acts to stop 'where grief exhausts itself'; in the Amiao (Weeping Temple) case of 1661 he was arrested with other literati and beheaded at Nanjing for 'inciting disorder', smiling at his death, his last words a joke about dried tofu and peanuts tasting of ham together; the pingdian (marginal commentary) genre became a dominant learning through his hands, 'Jin's comments' influencing the Rou-shi Zhai comments on Dream of the Red Chamber and three centuries of fiction criticism

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与黄宗羲同为明清之际的江南遗民，同以'体制外的著述'承载亡国之痛而体裁互补：黄宗羲以史论与学案存文献、续学统（明儒学案），金圣叹以评点存文章、立小说本体（才子书）；一个把政治判断写进史学体裁，一个把政治判断写进'惊恶梦'的叙事切口——同一'不仕之节'的两种表达，一严一狂，殊途而同归于'国亡而学不亡'。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Huang Zongxi, both Jiangnan loyalists at the Ming-Qing transition, carried the pain of a fallen dynasty through extrainstitutional writing in complementary genres: Huang preserved documents and continued the scholarly lineage through historical essays and case-books (the Mingru Xue'an); Jin preserved writing and grounded fiction's autonomy through commentary (the books of genius); one wrote political judgment into the historiographical genre, the other into a narrative cut of 'a dreadful dream' — one refusal of office, two expressions, one stern one wild, converging on 'the state perished; the learning did not'.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与王充相隔十五个世纪而同守'文本自主判断'的批评家立场：王充《论衡》'疾虚妄'以经验证据拒斥权威经义，金圣叹以'因文生事'拒斥'载道'文学观——两人都拒绝向官方标准申请合法性，都用自己的评价体系重排典籍地位（《论衡》自列八十五篇，金圣叹自立'才子书'名单）；王充为理性批判立法，金圣叹为审美批判立法。
cross_references.description_en: Fifteen centuries apart, Jin Shengtan and Wang Chong held the same critic's stance of autonomous textual judgment: Wang's Lunheng 'attacking the false' with evidential rigor against orthodox classics, Jin's 'generating events from writing' against the instrumental 'carrying-the-Way' view of literature — both refusing to petition official standards for legitimacy, both reseating the canon by their own systems (Wang listing his own eighty-five pian; Jin erecting the 'books of genius'); Wang legislated for rational criticism, Jin for aesthetic criticism.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与司马迁代表叙事写作的两种生成逻辑：司马迁'以文运事'——事实先在而文字追摹，实录是最高律令；金圣叹'因文生事'——文字先行而事件随生，虚构自有其合法性。金圣叹以这条界线把小说从史传中解放出来，却同时承认《史记》为'才子书'之一——分界而不同贬，划清叙事学疆界的同时向叙事大师致意。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Sima Qian embody two generative logics of narrative: Sima 'drives events by writing' — facts precede, words pursue them, fidelity the supreme law; Jin 'generates events from writing' — words first, events arising with them, fiction legitimate in itself. Jin drew this line to liberate the novel from historiography, yet ranked the Shiji among the books of genius — a boundary without disparagement, mapping narratology while saluting its master.

cross_references.description_zh: 金圣叹与董仲舒代表文学家与制度关系的两极：董仲舒以'天人三策'进入权力核心、以经学塑造帝国意识形态——著作的价值由制度承认加冕；金圣叹明亡不仕、以民间评点自立法度——著作的价值由市场流通加冕。前者示范'建制内经典化'的峰值，后者示范'体制外经典化'的可行性：中国书籍史因此有了'钦定'与'自选'两条并行的经典化通道。
cross_references.description_en: Jin Shengtan and Dong Zhongshu mark two poles of the writer's relation to institutions: Dong entered the seat of power with the 'three responses on Heaven and Man', shaping imperial ideology through the classics — a work's value crowned by institutional recognition; Jin, refusing office after the Ming fell, legislated for himself through private commentary — a work's value crowned by circulation in the market. The first shows the peak of canonization within the establishment, the second the viability of canonization outside it: Chinese book history thus holds two parallel channels, 'imperially sanctioned' and 'self-selected'.

modes.domain_zh: 把人物的性格当作作品的独立价值与第一分析单位：人物不是情节的执行者，而是有自己的性情、气质、形状、声口的生命体——评价一部叙事作品先看它把人写'活'了没有，再看故事如何安排
modes.domain_en: Treat character as the work's independent value and primary analytic unit: persons are not executors of plot but living beings with temperament, manner, appearance and voice — judge a narrative first by whether its people are alive, then by how the story is arranged
modes.source_chapter: 《第五才子书水浒传》序三及读第五才子书法
modes.key_quote_zh: 叙一百八人，人有其性情，人有其气质，人有其形状，人有其声口
modes.key_quote_en: 'One hundred and eight men are narrated; each has his temperament, each his manner, each his appearance, each his voice.'
process_zh: 把'人物是否成立'置于'情节是否精彩'之前：评价叙事作品的第一问不是故事讲得如何，而是人写得真不真
为每个人物建立多维权档案：性情（内在气质）、形状（外观言行）、声口（说话方式）逐一分梳——人物的可辨识度是四维而非一维
以'同题异写'检验功力：同类人物（如武松与石秀之勇、林冲与杨志之困）放在一处对照，看作者能否写出差异——写得活是天赋，写得别是功夫
从人物声口反推作者：能写千人千口者通人性，只能写自己者徒有辞章——批评的落点是作者对人性的理解力
process_en: Put 'does the character stand' before 'is the plot thrilling': the first question for a narrative is not how the story is told but how true the persons are written
Build a multi-dimensional dossier per character: temperament (inner), appearance (deed and look), voice (manner of speech) — recognizability is four-dimensional, not one

Test craft by same-type contrast: parallel characters — two kinds of courage, two kinds of plight — set side by side to see whether the author can write the difference; writing alive is gift, writing distinct is craft
Reason back from voice to author: one who can write a thousand mouths knows human nature; one who can write only himself has mere rhetoric — criticism lands on the author's grasp of humanity
representative_cases_zh: 《读第五才子书法》：'《水浒传》只是写人粗鲁处，便有许多写法'——鲁达粗鲁是性急、史进粗鲁是少年任气、李逵粗鲁是蛮、武松粗鲁是豪杰不受羁靮——同一标签下的四副面孔
武松打虎与李逵杀虎对照：同一母题写出两种人格——金批以对照法证明'性格'先于'情节'
对《西厢》红娘声口的批点：一个侍女的说话方式单独成为批评对象——人物等级的突破
representative_cases_en: In 'How to Read the Fifth Book of Genius': 'The Water Margin writes roughness in many ways' — Lu Da's roughness is impatience, Shi Jin's youthful daring, Li Kui's wildness, Wu Song's unbridled heroism — four faces under one label
Wu Song killing the tiger against Li Kui killing the tiger: one motif, two personalities — the Jin comments prove character precedes plot by contrast
Commenting on Hongniang's voice in the Western Chamber: a maidservant's way of speaking becomes an object of criticism on its own — a breakthrough in character hierarchy
modern_applications_zh: 产品与组织的人才评估：'性格画像'先于'履历清单'——同一'执行力强'标签下分出性急之勇、任气之勇、蛮干之勇与不受羁之勇四种质地
用户研究的人物分析法：不做扁平 persona，为每类用户建立动机/气质/行为/语言四维档案并做同类型对照
写作与编剧训练：先为角色写'声口小样'（此人开口第一句话必然怎么说），情节再服从于人物
modern_applications_en: Talent assessment in product and organization: character portraits before resume checklists — under one 'strong execution' label, four textures: impatience, daring, wildness, unbridled heroism
User-research character analysis: no flat personas; four-dimensional dossiers (motivation, temperament, behavior, language) per user type, with same-type contrast
Writing and screenwriting training: draft each role's 'voice sample' — how this person must open their mouth — plot yields to person
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
司马迁（上游：'人有其声口'的纪传体先声——《史记》以对话立人物）
脂砚斋（传承：金批体例移用于《红楼梦》人物批评）
福斯特（跨文明平行：'扁平人物/圆形人物'的现代小说理论同构）

modes.name_en: The Method of Engineering the Reader
modes.domain_zh: 把'如何阅读'本身做成显式的可教方法：不假定读者自然会读，而以读法总纲、回前总评、文中夹批三层结构配置读者的注意力——批评的对象从作品扩展到读者，文本效果由设计达成而非依赖运气
modes.domain_en: Make 'how to read' itself an explicit, teachable method: never assume readers naturally know how — configure the reader's attention through a three-tier structure of reading instructions, chapter prefaces, and interlinear comments; the object of criticism extends from work to reader, and textual effect is achieved by design, not luck
modes.source_chapter: 《读第五才子书法》与《西厢记》评点体例
modes.key_quote_zh: 大凡读书，先要晓得作书之人是何心胸
modes.key_quote_en: 'Before reading, one must first know what sort of heart and mind the author had.'
process_zh: 写'读法'总纲：全书读前先交付阅读规则——哪些是眼、哪些是背面铺粉、何处当快读何处当细读——把隐性阅读技巧显式化
分层配置批语：回前总评立骨架、文中夹批对现场、眉批提全局——每层只干一件事，读者在任何位置都有恰好的辅助
为'初次遭遇'设计：预判读者会在何处误解、何处错过妙处，批语在误读发生之前落位——防错优先于纠错
训练迁移而非喂养结论：批语示范'看到什么就问什么'，使读者读完能脱离批语独立读——工程的目标是读者自主
process_en: Write the reading instructions first: deliver the rules before the book — what to watch for, what is painted beneath the surface, where to race and where to linger — implicit technique made explicit
Layer the comments: chapter prefaces set the frame, interlinear notes meet the moment, margin notes hold the whole — each tier one duty, apt help at every position
Design for first encounter: predict where readers will misread or miss the point, and place comments before the misreading happens — error prevention over error correction
Train transfer, not conclusions: comments demonstrate 'what to see, what to ask', so readers finish able to read unaided — the goal of the engineering is reader autonomy
representative_cases_zh: 《读第五才子书法》十五则：'草蛇灰线法''绵针泥刺法''背面铺粉法'——为叙事技法命名并教读者认出，技法从隐学变显学
夹批'此一句直照后文某某事'：在伏笔埋设处即时提示，读者初读即见千里照应——防'错过'的装置
《西厢》评本对读者'不可囫囵吞'的屡次告诫：阅读速度本身被纳入批评对象
representative_cases_en: The fifteen 'how to read' instructions: the 'grey-thread-of-a-snake' method, the 'needle-in-mud' method, 'powder-painted-on-the-back' — naming narrative techniques and teaching readers to spot them, craft made explicit
Interlinear notes like 'this line shines all the way to such-and-such later': foreshadowing flagged at burial so first-time readers see the thousand-mile echo — an anti-miss device
Repeated admonitions in the Western Chamber edition 'do not gulp this down': reading speed itself brought inside the object of criticism
modern_applications_zh: 文档站与课程的'学习路径设计'：先交付读法（先读什么、可跳过什么、何处精读），再交付内容
代码评审的分层注释规范：reviewer 评论分'必须改''建议''提问'三层，与夹批/总评/眉批同构
UX 引导设计：预判新用户会在哪一步误解，把提示放在误操作之前——防错优先于纠错
modern_applications_en: Learning-path design for docs and courses: deliver the reading method first (what to read, what to skip, what to study), then the content
Tiered comment discipline in code review: reviewer remarks in three strata — must-fix, suggestion, question — isomorphic to interlinear, preface, margin
UX onboarding: predict where new users will misstep and place hints before the error — prevention over correction
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
刘勰（上游：《文心雕龙》以'知音'论把'如何读'立为学问）
脂砚斋（传承：批语体系承金批而自成一格）
艾柯（跨文明平行：《开放的作品》把读者位置纳入文本设计）

modes.name_en: The Method of Cutting as Argument
modes.category: 编辑方法论/批评即创作
modes.domain_zh: 用文本结构本身表达批评判断：腰斩《水浒》于七十回'惊恶梦'以断招安、截《西厢》四本一折以'足恸哭而止'——删改不是破坏而是立论，批评家以编辑权行使批评权，被裁剪后的文本就是批评文本
modes.domain_en: Express critical judgment through textual structure itself: lop the Water Margin at chapter seventy's 'dreadful dream' to end the amnesty, halve the Western Chamber 'where grief exhausts itself' — cutting is not vandalism but argument; the critic exercises the right of criticism through the right of editing, and the cut text is the critical text
modes.source_chapter: 《第五才子书》七十回本'惊恶梦'结局与《第六才子书》四本一折本
modes.key_quote_zh: 一部书七十回，可谓大铺排；一千八百五十段，可谓大经纬……后人只怕读之，不怕删之
modes.key_quote_en: 'Seventy chapters — what vast arrangement; one thousand eight hundred and fifty passages — what vast design... later readers need only fear not reading it, not the cutting.'
process_zh: 确认批评结论先行：先有'招安是败笔''全剧当止于恸哭'的判断，再寻找表达判断的文本手段——裁剪是结论的载体而非出发点
以'完整感'为手术刀：切口必须落在叙事自然收束处（'惊恶梦'接续卢俊义噩梦），使删改后的文本自洽而非残缺
为改动立据：凡删必说明其意义（'天下太平'四字为朝廷讳而作者心恨之）——编辑行为公开可查，拒绝暗改
承担裁剪的全部后果：接受'改窜古本'的骂名——判断的代价由判断者支付，批评才有重量
process_en: Conclusion precedes the cut: hold the verdict first — 'the amnesty is a failure', 'the play should end where grief exhausts itself' — then find the textual means to express it; cutting is the vehicle of the conclusion, not its origin
Cut where completeness lives: the incision falls at the narrative's natural closure (a 'dreadful dream' annexed), so the amended text is self-consistent, not mutilated

Give grounds for every change: each deletion justified in meaning ('the four words peace-under-heaven are the court's honorific and the author's bitter irony') — editing public and inspectable, never covert
Bear the full cost of cutting: accept the charge of 'tampering with the ancient text' — the price of judgment paid by the judge, or criticism weighs nothing
representative_cases_zh: 《水浒》七十回本以卢俊义'惊恶梦'作结：一百单八将被一网打尽——金圣叹借'梦'的叙事接口续写半页而断全书，结构即政治论
《西厢》四本一折'惊梦'止：后四折被断为'续'并斥之，'何用续，何可续，何足续'——以截断表达悲剧美学
改动原文时逐处批明：何处为'俗本'讹、何处为施耐庵原文——修订与裁断并行可查
representative_cases_en: The seventy-chapter Water Margin ending in Lu Junyi's 'dreadful dream': the hundred and eight swept away in one net — half a page annexed through a dream's narrative joint, structure as political argument

The Western Chamber stopped at the dream end of Act One of Book Four: the last four acts declared an 'appendage' and rejected — 'why continue, how continue, what worth continuing' — tragedy asserted by amputation
Every alteration of the original annotated in place: where the 'vulgar edition' erred, where Shi Nai'an's text stood — revision and verdict parallel and inspectable
modern_applications_zh: 主编对合集与选本的结构性裁断：选谁、断在何处本身就是立场——选本的批评力量大于序言
重构遗留系统时的'裁剪即架构'：砍掉哪些模块、切在何接口处，是对系统价值的最终表态
影视改编的'以剪代评'：剪辑节奏直接表达对故事的评价——剪辑台是最后的批评席
modern_applications_en: An editor's structural verdict in anthologies: whom to include, where to stop — selection itself is a stance, stronger than any preface
'Cutting as architecture' in refactoring legacy systems: which modules to sever and at which interface is the final statement of the system's value
'Editing as criticism' in film adaptation: cutting rhythm expresses judgment of the story directly — the editing room is the last critical seat
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
司马迁（对照：删改与存真之辨——《史记》以去取立褒贬而拒绝改字）
脂砚斋（平行：以批不改文——批评权与编辑权的另一分配）
庞德（跨文明平行：'要少作'的删削诗学，以编辑权立文学标准）
modes.definition_zh: 用文本结构本身表达批评判断：腰斩《水浒》于七十回'惊恶梦'以断招安、截《西厢》四本一折以'足恸哭而止'——删改不是破坏而是立论，批评家以编辑权行使批评权，被裁剪后的文本就是批评文本
modes.definition_en: Express critical judgment through textual structure itself: lop the Water Margin at chapter seventy's 'dreadful dream' to end the amnesty, halve the Western Chamber 'where grief exhausts itself' — cutting is not vandalism but argument; the critic exercises the right of criticism through the right of editing, and the cut text is the critical text

modes.domain_zh: 以'才子书'重排经典谱系，把被士大夫贬为小道的小说戏曲抬入《离骚》《庄子》《史记》的同列：不请求旧权威承认，而自立评价体系重排座次——通过重命名经典名单完成一次文化权力的重新分配
modes.domain_en: Reorder the canon under the banner of 'books of genius', lifting fiction and drama — dismissed by literati as trivial paths — into the company of the Li Sao, Zhuangzi and Shiji: do not petition the old authorities for recognition, but erect your own evaluative system and reseat the seats — redistribution of cultural power achieved by renaming the canon list
modes.source_chapter: 《第五才子书》序一、《第六才子书》序及读法
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下之文章，无有出《水浒》右者
modes.key_quote_en: 'Under heaven there is no writing that stands to the right of the Water Margin.'
process_zh: 宣布自己的标准：以'才'（创作才能）取代'道'（道德正统）为最高评价尺度——换标准是重排座次的前提
把低端体裁挂在高端谱系上：《水浒》与《史记》《庄子》同列——借既有权威的势能为新体裁定价
以完整著作落实标准：不是宣言而是评本——评点、删改、读法三件套让新经典'可读可用'，标准长出实体
预言并利用传播：'学者必须读'的口吻自我赋权，评本成为士人案头读物——体系靠实际流通而非官方承认立住
process_en: Declare your own standard: replace 'the Way' (orthodox morality) with 'genius' (creative power) as the supreme measure — a new standard is the precondition of reseating the canon
Hang the low genre on the high lineage: the Water Margin alongside Shiji and Zhuangzi — the old authorities' potential energy prices the new genre
Make the standard real with complete works: not a manifesto but an edition — commentary, cutting, reading instructions make the new classic readable and usable; the standard grows a body
Predict and exploit circulation: the self-authorizing tone 'students must read', editions entering literati desks — the system stands on actual circulation, not official blessing
representative_cases_zh: '六才子书'名单（庄、骚、马、杜、水、西）：小说戏曲与诗骚史传同榜——名谓'六'而实为一次文体平权运动
《水浒》称'第五才子书'并冠以施耐庵名号：给白话小说立'作者'与'地位'——批评本附带了一次经典化工程
评本以'天下才子必读书'名义流传：书商与批评家合作把标准推向市场——文化策略走商业通道
representative_cases_en: The list of six books of genius (Zhuangzi, Li Sao, Sima Qian, Du Fu, the Water Margin, the Western Chamber): fiction and drama ranked with poetry and history — a movement of genre equality under a name of 'six'
The Water Margin titled 'fifth book of genius' and crowned with Shi Nai'an's name: authorship and status granted to a vernacular novel — every edition carrying a canonization campaign
Editions circulating as 'books all geniuses must read': bookseller and critic pushing the standard through the market — cultural strategy via commercial channels
modern_applications_zh: 新兴领域自建评价体系：不申请旧学会承认，而自设奖项、榜单、教材——'标准权'是领域话语权的地基
开源项目的经典化：以'必读清单''核心书单'重构技术谱系，把边缘工具抬入主流谱系
创作者经济中的类型平权：为'游戏''播客'等新体裁自评'才子书'，绕过传统媒体权威
modern_applications_en: Emerging fields building their own evaluative systems: no petition to old academies — self-founded awards, rankings, textbooks; 'the right to set standards' is the ground of discourse power
Canonization in open source: 'must-read lists' rebuilding the technical genealogy, lifting marginal tools into the mainstream lineage
Genre equality in the creator economy: self-crowned 'books of genius' for games and podcasts, bypassing legacy media authority
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
萧统（上游：《文选》以'事出于沉思，义归乎翰藻'另立文学标准）
袁宏道（平行：晚明'独抒性灵'把小说与诗文同贵）
哈罗德·布鲁姆（跨文明平行：《西方正典》以'陌生性'重排经典座次）

modes.name_en: The Method of Play Against Death
modes.domain_zh: 以审美游戏的态度覆盖生命全境直至死亡：临刑笑语、遗言是豆腐干与花生米的滋味玩笑——不把死亡当作恐怖的例外而当作最后的文体现场，审美主体的自由在生命尽头完成最后一次演示
modes.domain_en: Cover the whole of life with an aesthetic-playful attitude down to death: smiling at the executioner, the last words a joke about dried tofu and peanuts tasting of ham — not treating death as a terrifying exception but as the final scene of style; the aesthetic subject's freedom performs one last demonstration at the edge of life
modes.source_chapter: 哭庙案临刑记载与《沉吟楼诗选》绝命诗
modes.key_quote_zh: 杀头，至痛也，而圣叹以无意得之
modes.key_quote_en: 'Beheading is the extremity of pain; yet Shengtan obtained it as if by accident.'
process_zh: 承认死亡不可谈判：不逃避、不祷免、不哀告——先把最坏结局纳入视野是游戏态度的前提
把恐惧转写为文体：绝命诗、笑语、遗言逐一经营——终局被当作'一生最后一次表达机会'来使用
在极小处安放趣味：豆腐干与花生米——趣味的对象越琐屑，对死亡权重的消解越彻底
以幽默完成自主：笑声宣告'谁在临刑谁做主'——被剥夺一切之后仍保留对现场意义的解释权
process_en: Admit death is non-negotiable: no flight, no prayer for pardon, no wailing — the worst outcome brought into view first, the precondition of play
Transmute fear into style: the farewell poem, the smile, the last words each composed — the end treated as life's final chance at expression
Install delight in the smallest things: tofu and peanuts — the more trivial the object of relish, the more thorough the dissolving of death's weight
Complete autonomy with humor: the laugh declares 'whoever is on the scaffold runs the scene' — stripped of everything, the right to interpret the moment's meaning is kept
representative_cases_zh: 哭庙案狱中致女儿书：'花生米与豆腐干同嚼，大有火腿之滋味'——绝命书以趣谈告终，家属免于悲恸失措
临刑'饮酒自若，且说且笑'：刑场被当作'文章'的最后一节——观者先怯而士子气不折
《绝命诗》'鼠肝虫臂久萧疏'：以庄子式齐物提前与自己的身体和解——死亡在文本里先被排练过
representative_cases_en: The prison letter to his daughter: 'peanuts chewed with dried tofu have the very savor of ham' — the farewell ends in jest, sparing the family helpless grief
At the scaffold 'drinking calm, talking and laughing as he went': the execution ground treated as the last section of a 'composition' — spectators unnerved, the scholar's bearing unbroken
The deathbed poem 'long since worn thin as rat's liver, insect's arm': Zhuangzian equanimity reconciling with one's own body in advance — death rehearsed inside the text first
modern_applications_zh: 危机沟通中的幽默运用：坏消息交付时以小趣味维持人格完整——幽默是压力下的自主权
临终关怀与'生前告别会'：把死亡纳入可经营的现场（音乐、故事、玩笑），而非纯粹的医疗事件
高压职业的心理韧性训练：'把最坏结果当作业已排练的文本'——恐惧管理理论的日常化
modern_applications_en: Humor in crisis communication: delivering bad news while keeping the person intact through small delight — humor as autonomy under pressure
Hospice care and living funerals: death brought into a stageable scene (music, stories, jokes) rather than a purely medical event
Psychological resilience training for high-stress professions: 'treat the worst case as a text already rehearsed' — terror management made daily
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
庄子（上游：鼓盆而歌、'鼠肝虫臂'的齐物生死观）
嵇康（平行：《广陵散》临刑自若——士人以终局演奏自主）
苏格拉底（跨文明平行：赴死论谈从容，死亡作为最后的哲学演示）

modes.domain_zh: 把文学从'载道''征实'的工具论中解放出来，确认虚构本身的价值：《水浒》'因文生事'而非'以文运事'——小说是文字自己的事业，虚构不必向史实申请合法性
modes.domain_en: Liberate literature from instrumental theories of 'carrying the Way' and 'recording fact', affirming the value of fiction as such: the Water Margin 'generates events from writing' rather than 'driving events by writing' — the novel is writing's own enterprise; fiction need not apply to history for legitimacy
modes.source_chapter: 《第五才子书》序三'因文生事'论
modes.key_quote_zh: 《史记》是以文运事，《水浒》是因文生事。以文运事，是先有事生成如此如此，却要算计出一篇文章来……因文生事，却只是顺笔写去
modes.key_quote_en: 'The Shiji drives events by writing; the Water Margin generates events from writing. To drive events by writing is to have the facts given and then contrive an essay out of them... to generate events from writing is simply to follow the brush and write on.'
process_zh: 建立对照系：以史传（《史记》）为参照界碑，划出'纪实'与'虚构'两类文本的不同生成逻辑——比较使本体可见
为虚构正名的核心论证：'因文生事'——事件由文字生成而非先在，文学的完成度在文字自身——把批评标准从'是否属实'移到'文如何成'
推论到技法：虚构自由使作者可以'为人物设计最妙声口'——本体论直接产出创作论与批评论
以评本实践本体论：评点对象是'文'而非'事'——全书批语贯彻'此文妙在何处'的纯文学追问
process_en: Build a contrast set: historical prose (the Shiji) as boundary marker, separating the generative logics of record and fiction — comparison makes the ontology visible

The core argument for fiction: 'generating events from writing' — events arise from the text, not before it; literary completeness lies in the writing itself — the criterion shifts from 'is it true' to 'how is it written'
Infer the craft: fictional freedom lets the author 'design the finest voice for a person' — ontology yields directly a poetics and a criticism
Practice the ontology in the edition: what is commented on is 'the writing', not 'the happenings' — the whole apparatus pursues the purely literary question 'where lies the excellence of this text'
representative_cases_zh: 序三'以文运事/因文生事'之辨：中国文论第一次系统区分历史写作与虚构写作的生成机制
批《水浒》'倒插法''夹叙法'皆落到文字经营而非史实考证：评点的兴奋点全在'怎么写'
对'乱自上作'的史论性批语仍服务于文章分析：政治判断内嵌于文学批评而不取代它
representative_cases_en: The preface-three distinction 'driving events by writing' versus 'generating events from writing': Chinese criticism's first systematic separation of the generative mechanics of history and fiction
Comments on the Water Margin's 'inverted insertion' and 'interleaved narration' landing on verbal craft, not historical verification: the excitement of the notes is all 'how it is written'
Historiographical comments like 'disorder comes from above' still serving textual analysis: political judgment embedded in, not displacing, literary criticism
modern_applications_zh: 工程中的'形式优先'判断：架构评审区分'讲清楚'（文字质量）与'做正确'（事实正确）两种验收——文档的本体是可读性
创作领域的方法自觉：编剧区分'基于真实事件'与'为人物生成事件'两套工作流，不以真实之名捆绑虚构
批判性写作训练：区分论证的事实层与修辞层，评价议论文先看'文如何成'再看'据是否实'
modern_applications_en: 'Form-first' judgment in engineering: architecture review separating 'clarity' (text quality) from 'correctness' (factual accuracy) — a document's being is its readability
Craft self-awareness in creation: screenwriters keep two workflows, 'based on true events' versus 'generating events for the person', refusing to shackle fiction in fact's name
Critical writing training: separating the factual layer of an argument from the rhetorical — judge an essay first by how it is written, then whether its evidence holds

李贽（上游：'童心说'为通俗文学张目的先驱）
冯梦龙（平行：'情教'说与通俗小说整理——同一平权的另一翼）
王尔德（跨文明平行：'生活模仿艺术'的审美主义本体论）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Eccentric's Integrity
modes.domain_zh: 以'狂'作为独立人格的公开形式：名不避俗、言不避怪、行不避骇——狂不是姿态而是手段，用可预期的越轨为不可协商的内核（评点事业、不仕之节）争取空间
modes.domain_en: Use 'eccentricity' as the public form of an independent personhood: a name that shuns not the vulgar, words that shun not the strange, acts that shun not the startling — eccentricity is not a pose but a means, using predictable transgression to win room for the non-negotiable core (the critical enterprise, the refusal of office)
modes.source_chapter: 金圣叹生平行事与《沉吟楼诗选》
modes.key_quote_zh: 自古至今，止我一人是大材，余皆凡材
modes.key_quote_en: 'From antiquity to now, I alone am great material; all the rest are common stock.'
process_zh: 把内核与外围分开：内核是绝不动摇的事业与节操（评点、不仕新朝），外围是可让渡的名声与体统——狂在外围活动以保护内核
以怪异筛选环境：惊世言行预先吓退不兼容者（官府、俗儒），留下的交际圈全是同调——狂是社交过滤器
把自大做成学理：'余皆凡材'式的狂言底下是严格标准——对自身事业的高要求借狂语表达而不失风度
承担狂的全部代价：科场黜革、临刑就戮——狂的账单照单全收，人格策略才自洽
process_en: Split core from periphery: the core — the enterprise and the refusal of the new dynasty — unshakable; the periphery — reputation and decorum — negotiable; eccentricity operates on the periphery to shield the core
Filter the environment with strangeness: startling words and acts pre-empt incompatible company (officialdom, pedants); what remains of the circle is all kindred — eccentricity as a social filter
Make arrogance into doctrine: beneath 'all the rest are common stock' lies a strict standard — extreme demands on one's own enterprise voiced without loss of grace
Pay eccentricity's full bill: struck from the examination rolls, dying on the scaffold — invoices honored in full, or the personhood strategy collapses
representative_cases_zh: 科考时'人瑞'附会与改籍冒姓金：用近乎荒诞的方式处理科名——科名被降格为可戏弄之物
扶乩降坛以'泐大师'名动公卿（早岁谭天故事争议存疑而名满江南）：以表演性神秘扩大批评事业的影响半径
明亡后不受荐举、以评点自晦：狂于言而慎于节——外围的放达从未透支内核的立场
representative_cases_en: Changing his registered surname to Jin before the examination, with half-burlesque talk of auspiciousness: the examination degree demoted to something toyable-with
In youth the planchette séances of 'Master Le', famous across Jiangnan (tales disputed yet fame real): performative mystery widening the reach of the critical enterprise
After the Ming fell, refusing recommendation and hiding within commentary: wild in speech, exact in principle — the periphery's abandon never overdraws the core's stance
modern_applications_zh: 独立职业者的'人设即护城河'：公开的怪癖筛选客户与伙伴，为不可协商的专业标准留出空间
技术社区的'狂语+硬核'组合：以挑衅性言论吸引注意力，以扎实产出兑现——注意力经济中的自制杠杆
组织中的异见者策略：用风格化的异议保护实质异议，越轨限定在外围话题而内核立场寸步不让
modern_applications_en: Persona as moat for independents: public eccentricity filters clients and partners, leaving room for non-negotiable professional standards
The 'wild words + hardcore output' pairing in tech communities: provocative speech draws attention, solid work redeems it — a self-made lever in the attention economy
Dissenter strategy in organizations: stylized dissent shielding substantive dissent — transgression confined to peripheral topics, core positions unyielding
representative_figures: 金圣叹（核心）
阮籍（上游：青白眼的狂士原型——以怪行筛选环境）
徐渭（平行：晚明狂士的极端形态）
第欧根尼（跨文明平行：以犬行立哲学人格——越轨作为立场的公开形式）
modes.definition_zh: 以'狂'作为独立人格的公开形式：名不避俗、言不避怪、行不避骇——狂不是姿态而是手段，用可预期的越轨为不可协商的内核（评点事业、不仕之节）争取空间
modes.definition_en: Use 'eccentricity' as the public form of an independent personhood: a name that shuns not the vulgar, words that shun not the strange, acts that shun not the startling — eccentricity is not a pose but a means, using predictable transgression to win room for the non-negotiable core (the critical enterprise, the refusal of office)

modes.name_en: The Method of Naming the Techniques
modes.domain_zh: 为阅读中发现的写作技法逐一起名立目：'草蛇灰线''绵针泥刺''背面铺粉''獭尾'——把不可言传的'文感'转译为可命名、可传授、可检索的概念目录，隐学变显学
modes.domain_en: Name each writing technique discovered in reading: 'grey thread of a snake', 'needle sewn in mud', 'powder painted on the back', 'the otter's tail' — translating unutterable literary feel into a namable, teachable, retrievable catalogue of concepts, hidden knowledge made explicit
modes.key_quote_zh: 有草蛇灰线法。如景阳冈勤叙许多'哨棒'字，紫石街连写若干'帘子'字等是也
modes.key_quote_en: 'There is the grey-thread-of-a-snake method: as when the tiger cliff keeps repeating the word 'club', and Purple Stone Street writes 'curtain' over and over.'
process_zh: 先感受后命名：反复细读直到'此处有手法'的感觉稳定——命名必须贴着真实感受，防止概念空心化
以意象命名：'草蛇灰线''背面铺粉'——名字自带画面，读者闻其名即能揣其意，降低传授成本
每法配实例：手法名后必附'如某某字、某某段'的书内证据——概念与文本互为注脚，目录可验证
编目交付：十五则读法结成体系并置于卷首——命名不是零散点评而是成套工具箱
process_en: Feel first, name second: reread until the sense 'there is a device here' is stable — the name must hug a real perception, or the concept hollows out
Name by image: 'grey thread of a snake', 'powder on the back' — the name carries its own picture; hear it and you grasp it, cutting teaching cost
Every name with evidence: behind each device, cited instances from the book itself — concept and text annotating each other, the catalogue verifiable
Deliver as a catalogue: fifteen reading-instructions as a system, placed at the head of the volume — naming is not scattered remarks but a complete toolbox
representative_cases_zh: '草蛇灰线法'：'哨棒'十八见、'帘子'十四见——以重复意象统计支撑的技法命名，近乎量化文学分析
'背面铺粉法'：'要衬宋江奸险，先写李逵真率'——对照修辞获得专名，后世批评直接引用
'獭尾法'：'一段文字临了必要荡开一笔'——节奏现象被命名，成为谈'章法'的通用词
representative_cases_en: 'Grey thread of a snake': the word 'club' eighteen times, 'curtain' fourteen — a technique named on repeated-image counts, quasi-quantitative literary analysis
'Powder painted on the back': 'to set off Song Jiang's cunning, first paint Li Kui's candor' — contrast rhetoric given a proper name, cited by critics ever after
'The otter's tail': 'a passage, at its close, must sweep aside one stroke' — rhythm named, a common term ever after for compositional cadence
modern_applications_zh: 工程实践的模式命名：'优雅停机''熔断''惊群'——命名让隐性经验可传授可检索，与'草蛇灰线'同一工程学
设计系统的组件命名法：为视觉手法（呼吸感、锚点、留白）建立带实例的目录
团队复盘的'现象词典'：为反复出现的协作问题命名（例：'暗桩依赖'），每名附实例——组织学习显学化
modern_applications_en: Pattern-naming in engineering practice: 'graceful shutdown', 'circuit breaker', 'thundering herd' — naming makes tacit experience teachable and searchable, the same engineering as 'grey thread'
Component naming in design systems: a catalogue of visual devices (breathing room, anchors, whitespace) each with instances
A 'phenomenon dictionary' in team retrospectives: naming recurring collaboration problems (say, 'hidden-stake dependency'), each with examples — organizational learning made explicit

刘勰（上游：《文心雕龙》'隐秀''风骨'——概念命名的直接先驱）
司空图（平行：《二十四诗品》以意象名诗风）

modes.domain_zh: 王朝更替之际以拒绝出仕为立场表达：不用论辩与对抗，而用'不合作的位置'本身说话——把评点事业安放在体制之外，使拒绝成为可持续的生活方式而非一次性表态
modes.domain_en: At dynastic change, express a stance by refusing office: no polemic, no confrontation, but the 'position of non-cooperation' speaking for itself — installing the critical enterprise outside the system, making refusal a sustainable way of life rather than a one-time gesture
modes.source_chapter: 金圣叹明亡后行止与评点生涯
modes.key_quote_zh: 今人不会看书，往往将书容易混帐过去。于是古人书中所有得意处、不得意处、转笔处、难转笔处……都付之茫然
modes.key_quote_en: 'People today cannot read; they let the book slip past in a muddle. Thus all the author's delights and griefs, his turns and hard turns... are abandoned to blankness.'
process_zh: 评估新秩序的索价：出仕的代价是立场的让渡——先算清'接受什么就要放弃什么'，拒绝才有依据
选一个体制外的终身事业：评点不依赖朝廷、不耗节操——用可行的生存方式承载不可行的政治立场
以作品密度代替政治音量：不出条陈、不结社团、不发檄文——立场的表达收敛为案头劳作的持续输出
把拒绝常态化：不仕不是一次性决定而是逐日重申的选择——使立场与生活节奏合一，难以被收买也难以被摧毁
process_en: Price the new order's demand: office costs the surrender of stance — count what accepting means giving up, and refusal gains its ground
Choose a lifelong enterprise outside the system: commentary depends on no court, spends no principle — a workable livelihood carrying an unworkable political position
Substitute work-density for political volume: no memorials, no leagues, no proclamations — the stance's expression condensed into the steady output of desk labor
Normalize the refusal: not one decision but a daily reaffirmation — stance fused with the rhythm of living, hard to buy and hard to destroy
representative_cases_zh: 明亡后绝意仕进、以评点自给：新朝功名之途被整体关闭的同时，批评事业全部转入民间出版
评本序言中'圣叹'自号的自许：不与新朝文网正面冲突而自立志业——拒绝以'名'的形式长期在场
哭庙案中列名文告：最后的公开行动仍是'秀才'身份的集体行为——体制外者的立场以体制允许的形式表达
representative_cases_en: After the Ming fell, abandoning office and living by commentary: with the new dynasty's examination path shut, the critical enterprise moved wholly into private publishing
The self-appellation 'Shengtan' in edition prefaces: no frontal clash with the new dynasty's literary inquisition, yet a career self-declared — refusal persisting as a name
His name on the temple-weeping proclamation: the last public act still collective behavior of 'students' — an outsider's stance voiced in the form the system permitted
modern_applications_zh: 专业人士对不良雇主的'用脚投票'：不诉诸对抗而以离开+独立执业承载立场——拒绝成为生活方式
开源社区的'另起炉灶'：对治理不满不内耗夺权而 fork 立业——体制外建设的非暴力路径
学术界的'体制外学者'：拒绝依附课题体系，以独立研究保持议程自主
modern_applications_en: 'Voting with one's feet' against a bad employer: no confrontation, but leaving plus independent practice as the vehicle of stance — refusal as a way of life
'Forking' in open source: dissatisfied with governance, not seizing power from within but building outside — the nonviolent path of extrainstitutional construction
The independent scholar in academia: refusing dependence on the grant system, keeping agenda autonomy through independent research

modes.domain_zh: 批评的最高姿态不是裁决而是悲悯：读《西厢》至'哭宴'谓'足恸哭而止'，读《水浒》见英雄末路而预笔哀之——批评家与作者、人物同呼吸，判断力与同情心并行不悖
modes.domain_en: The highest posture of criticism is not verdict but compassion: reading the Western Chamber to 'the feast of tears' — 'stop where grief exhausts itself'; reading the Water Margin to the heroes' dead end and grieving in advance — critic, author and characters breathing together, judgment and sympathy running in parallel without conflict
modes.source_chapter: 《第六才子书》'哭宴'批语与《第五才子书》人物批语
modes.key_quote_zh: 我于此书，不是赞其文，是悲其事
modes.key_quote_en: 'In this book, what I honor is not the writing but I grieve for the matter.'
process_zh: 先入乎其内：评点前先全然代入作者与人物的心境——理解优先于评价，'晓得作书人是何心胸'
以身体反应为批评证据：'恸哭''绝倒'式的批语承认阅读的情绪实况——批评不假装冷静而把感受如实记录
再出乎其外：情绪沉浸后回到结构分析——悲悯不取消判断，判断以理解为基础而更准
对人物存哀矜：即使批'奸'亦见其'不得不奸'的处境——批评的严苛之下保留对人的体恤
process_en: Enter first: before commenting, wholly inhabit the author's and characters' state of mind — understanding before verdict, 'know what sort of heart the author had'
Take bodily response as critical evidence: comments of 'weeping' and 'laughing helplessly' admit reading's emotional actuality — criticism does not feign coolness but records feeling as felt
Then exit: after immersion, return to structural analysis — compassion does not cancel judgment; judgment grounded in understanding is sharper
Keep mercy toward characters: even when condemning the 'cunning', see the plight that made it unavoidable — under criticism's strictness, tenderness for persons preserved
representative_cases_zh: 《西厢》'哭宴'回批：'今日之宴，为其恸哭也'——长亭送别被读作人类离别的普遍悲恸而不仅是一折戏文
《水浒》批林冲：一路忍到山神庙，批语层层'读到此处，使人泪下'——对被逼反者的全程共情
批宋江之'奸'仍细析其处境逻辑：道德裁决与处境理解并置——批评家的复杂人格
representative_cases_en: The chapter comment on 'the feast of tears': 'today's feast — weeping is its meaning' — the farewell at the long pavilion read as the universal grief of parting, not a scene alone
Commenting on Lin Chong, enduring chapter by chapter to the Mountain God temple: the notes saying 'reading here, one weeps' —全程 empathy for the man forced to rebel
On Song Jiang's 'cunning', still dissecting the logic of his plight: moral verdict and situational understanding juxtaposed — the critic's complex personhood
modern_applications_zh: 代码评审的'先懂后评'：读懂作者当时的约束与权衡再提意见——评审意见的可接受度大幅提升
用户研究的共情方法：以'恸哭点'定位产品的情绪关键时刻，功能排序服从情绪事实
冲突调解：先复述对方处境至对方认可（'入乎其内'），再谈解决方案（'出乎其外'）
modern_applications_en: 'Understand first, then review' in code review: grasp the constraints and trade-offs the author faced before commenting — acceptance of the review rises sharply
Empathic method in user research: locating the product's 'moments of tears' as emotional critical points; feature ranking yields to emotional fact
Conflict mediation: restate the other's situation until they assent ('enter first'), then discuss solutions ('then exit')
